findings.claim: The only continuous-trend row retrieved for the observed window is landmark_00_soft_mass, a predicted-endpoint world-coordinate feature; its whole-window z is small (0.639) while its first and last node rates are large and opposite in sign (first_rate_z 9.27, last_rate_z -10.00), with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict across 14 independent batches.

The landmark_00_soft_mass curve over the full observed support [0.0, 0.49] rises from a negative early value to a mid-window maximum near t~0.16-0.20 and then declines to a negative late value, i.e. a non-monotone arch rather than a stationary or monotone target; the cubic polynomial fit was not accepted (polynomial_accepted false, relative_node_RMSE 0.286) and extrapolation is disallowed.

The score clock is the native observed score-node grid 0.0 to 0.49 in 0.01 steps, with learning window [0.0, 0.5] and curve support [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and the label prior is equal-score, so decoded final affinity is unobserved in this input.

hypotheses.direction: early-window increase, late-window decrease; no single signed whole-window direction
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing a monotone profile, or a whole-window z whose magnitude dominates the endpoint rate z values, would falsify the non-monotone characterization.
hypotheses.statement: Within the observed score-node window, the landmark_00_soft_mass coordinate proxy is non-monotone: it increases early and decreases late, so any reward term keyed to this coordinate should be evaluated against a time-varying contrast rather than a single fixed endpoint target.

hypotheses.falsifier: A stable profile with independently stable per-batch rates and no strong sign conflicts would falsify the instability claim.
hypotheses.observable: first_rate_z, last_rate_z, sign_changes, strong_sign_conflicts for landmark_00_soft_mass
hypotheses.statement: The large opposing first/last node rates with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict indicate the landmark_00_soft_mass contrast is unstable across the window, so a reward that treats its time derivative as a coordinate target would be unsupported by this evidence.

limitations: Only one feature (landmark_00_soft_mass) was read as an actual curve; the remaining 199 catalogue features were not inspected, so no cross-feature comparison is claimed.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; no stage boundary or phase knot is supported by this evidence.
Decoded final affinity labels are removed/unobserved in this input, so no claim about descendant survival or measured final benefit is made.
The cubic polynomial fit was not accepted and extrapolation is disallowed; no values outside [0.0, 0.49] are asserted.
No energy, chemical-interaction, or neural-module interpretation is attached to this untyped coordinate proxy.
